_comment: Model rates in US DOLLARS PER MILLION TOKENS. Token counts in the run logs are measured (they come straight off the provider's usage object); money is estimated from this table. It ships EMPTY on purpose: this repo cannot know what your provider — OpenAI directly, or a LenAI deployment with negotiated rates — charges you today, and a stale guessed number would be logged as fact. Until a model has an entry here, runs report 'not priced' and the token counts carry the report.
_howToFill: Copy the _example entry into "models", key it by the model id the run log records (the part after the provider slash is matched too, so "gpt-4o-mini" covers "openai/gpt-4o-mini" and "lenai/gpt-4o-mini"), and put your own rates in. cachedInputPerMillionUsd is optional; leave it out when your provider does not discount cached prompt tokens.
